instruction: Clinic Suite Layout Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 1 building story, 5 spaces and 5 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Reception, Exam-1, Exam-2, Nurse and Storage. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 34 total OS:Surface objects, split into 5 floor surfaces, 5 roof/ceiling surfaces and 24 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 5 Ground, 15 Outdoors and 14 Surface. Do not add any subsurfaces or windows. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 5 ideal-loads air systems, 5 zone HVAC equipment lists and 5 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 14.00 m in X, 8.00 m in Y and 3.30 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 94.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 145.20 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
